name: Allée du Quotidien — Impasse des Rendormis · s'adosser, se rendormir, se dégourdir
note: Last place of the Allée du Quotidien (five verbs). -er LEFT (detective leaning back against the wall beside his gold-framed mirror, man in a dinner jacket cramming the little red car full of suitcases, man striking a pose with his rubber stamp on the balcony), -ir/-re RIGHT (man in pyjamas dozing off again in his deckchair, wren on the door knocker, round mirror; man stretching on the balcony beside his gourd and mirror). Forward = lane end, round back to the square; back = near cobbles.

items.mirror: gold-framed wall mirror reflecting the detective
round mirror on the wall beside the deckchair
mirror beside the gourd on the balcony
